kis-bahcesi.title: Winter Garden Systems
kis-bahcesi.short: Modern glass and aluminium solutions that make your living spaces usable in all four seasons.
kis-bahcesi.intro: Winter garden systems transform your garden, terrace and balcony areas into living spaces you can enjoy in comfort throughout the year. With highly thermally insulated aluminium profiles and special glass packages, we bring together aesthetics and performance.

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation
advantages.description: Energy savings with thermal-break profiles and insulated glass.

advantages.title: Four-Season Use
advantages.description: Cool in summer, warm in winter; uninterrupted comfort.

advantages.title: Modern Architecture
advantages.description: Slim profile lines and wide glass surfaces.

advantages.title: Custom-Size Manufacturing
advantages.description: Bespoke project design and production for every space.

faq.q: Can a winter garden be heated?
faq.a: Yes, with underfloor heating and air-conditioning integration, comfortable four-season use is possible.
Depending on size, an average project is completed within 3–7 working days.

bioklimatik-pergola.title: Bioclimatic Pergola
bioklimatik-pergola.short: Smart shading systems that control sun and rain with adjustable louvres.
bioklimatik-pergola.intro: Bioclimatic pergola systems let you control sunlight, ventilation and rain thanks to their motorised, adjustable aluminium louvres. They turn your outdoor areas into smart, comfortable living spaces.

advantages.title: Adjustable Louvres
advantages.description: Louvres that rotate 0–135° according to the sun angle.

advantages.title: Rain Protection
advantages.description: Full watertightness with drainage when closed.

advantages.title: Motorised Control
advantages.description: Remote control and smart-home integration.

advantages.title: Durable Structure
advantages.description: Wind-resistant aluminium construction.

faq.q: Does it let water through in the rain?
faq.a: No, when closed the water is drained via the integrated gutter system.

faq.q: Can it be used in winter?
faq.a: With side glass and heater integration it can be used in all four seasons.

ofis-bolme.title: Office Partition Systems
ofis-bolme.short: Slim-profile, sound-insulated glass partition solutions for modern workspaces.
ofis-bolme.intro: Office partition systems turn open offices into functional, airy and modern spaces. With slim aluminium profiles and single/double glazing options, they separate spaces without blocking light and provide sound insulation.

advantages.title: Airy Look
advantages.description: Divided yet bright spaces thanks to glass surfaces.

advantages.title: Sound Insulation
advantages.description: Acoustic comfort in meeting rooms with double glazing.

advantages.title: Modular Structure
advantages.description: Easy installation, disassembly and repositioning.

advantages.title: Elegant Design
advantages.description: Slim profiles and film options applicable to glass.

faq.q: Can privacy be provided on the glass?
faq.a: Privacy can be provided with frosted film, blinds or smart glass.
Thanks to the modular structure, partitions can be disassembled and repositioned.

aluminyum-dograma.title: Aluminium Joinery
aluminyum-dograma.short: High-strength, slim-profile modern façade and window joinery systems.
aluminyum-dograma.intro: Aluminium joinery systems are indispensable to modern architecture with their durability, slim-profile aesthetics and wide range of colours. With thermally insulated series, energy efficiency is at the forefront.

advantages.title: Long Life
advantages.description: Corrosion-resistant, maintenance-free structure.

advantages.title: Slim Profile
advantages.description: Wide glass area and maximum light.

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation
advantages.description: Thermal series with polyamide barriers.

advantages.title: Design Freedom
advantages.description: Wide range of colours and wood-look options.

faq.q: Can it have a wood look?
faq.a: Yes, wood-patterned coating options are available.
It is ideal for slimmer profiles, higher strength and large openings.

zip-perde.title: Zip Screen Systems
zip-perde.short: Wind-resistant modern outdoor sun-shading solutions with a channelled structure.
zip-perde.intro: Zip screen systems remain stable even in wind thanks to the fabric being fixed into side channels. They are a modern solution providing sun, insect and wind control outdoors.

advantages.title: Wind Resistance
advantages.description: Stable fabric thanks to the side-channel (zip) system.

advantages.title: Sun Control
advantages.description: Technical fabrics that reduce heat and UV.

advantages.title: Insect Protection
advantages.description: Insect barrier with the sealed structure.

advantages.title: Motorised Use
advantages.description: Remote and sun-sensor integration.

specs.label: Width
specs.value: Up to 4 metres in one piece

faq.q: Does the fabric fade in the sun?
faq.a: UV-resistant technical fabrics retain their colour for many years.
Semi-transparent screen fabric options that preserve the view are available.

giyotin-cam.title: Guillotine Glass Systems
giyotin-cam.short: Vertically opening, frameless-look, space-saving modern glass enclosure solutions.
giyotin-cam.intro: Guillotine glass systems let you effortlessly open and close a space by moving the glass vertically up and down. With their minimal profile structure they offer an uninterrupted view and a modern appearance.

advantages.title: Space Saving
advantages.description: Requires no extra space thanks to vertical movement.

advantages.title: Uninterrupted View
advantages.description: Maximum glass surface with a slim profile.

advantages.title: Easy Use
advantages.description: Quiet operation, manual or motorised.

advantages.title: Thermal & Sound Insulation
advantages.description: Comfortable interior with insulated glass.

faq.a: It provides high wind resistance with multi-point locking and a sturdy rail system.

faq.q: If the glass breaks, is it replaced?
faq.a: Thanks to the modular structure, a single panel can be easily replaced.

isi-camli-surme.title: Insulated Glass Sliding Systems
isi-camli-surme.short: Wide-opening sliding glass systems with high thermal insulation that slide to the side.
isi-camli-surme.intro: Insulated glass sliding systems seamlessly connect indoor and outdoor spaces by sliding wide glass surfaces to the side. With their double-glazed structure providing high thermal insulation, they offer four-season comfort.

advantages.title: Wide Opening
advantages.description: Airy transitions with large glass panels.

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation
advantages.description: Energy savings with double insulated glass.

advantages.title: Easy Use
advantages.description: Quiet and smooth sliding mechanism.

advantages.title: Modern Look
advantages.description: Uninterrupted view with a slim profile.

faq.q: Can an insect screen be fitted?
faq.a: Yes, pleated or sliding insect-screen integration is possible.

faq.q: Is the rail recessed into the floor?
faq.a: A floor-recessed rail can be applied for a threshold-free transition.

pvc-pencere.title: PVC Window Systems
pvc-pencere.short: Durable, maintenance-free PVC window solutions with high thermal and sound insulation.
pvc-pencere.intro: PVC window systems offer superior thermal and sound insulation thanks to their multi-chamber profile structure. With their maintenance-free surface, long life and wide range of colours, they create comfortable living spaces.

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation
advantages.description: Superior energy performance with a multi-chamber profile.

advantages.title: Sound Insulation
advantages.description: Quiet interior against city noise.

advantages.title: Security
advantages.description: Multi-point locking and security hardware.

advantages.title: Easy Maintenance
advantages.description: A paint-free, easy-to-clean surface.

faq.q: How long does a PVC window last?
faq.a: With quality profiles and hardware it provides 30+ years of trouble-free use.
A wide range of film coating colours, including wood, is available.

pvc-surme.title: Sliding PVC Systems
pvc-surme.short: Insulated PVC sliding systems that slide to the side, with wide openings and space savings.
pvc-surme.intro: Sliding PVC systems save space by sliding wide glass surfaces to the side and make the indoor-outdoor transition easier. With their highly insulated profile structure they are ideal for balcony, terrace and living-room transitions.

advantages.title: Space Saving
advantages.description: Requires no extra space thanks to the side-sliding structure.

advantages.title: High Insulation
advantages.description: Energy savings with a multi-chamber profile.

advantages.title: Easy Use
advantages.description: Quiet and smooth sliding mechanism.

advantages.title: Wide Opening
advantages.description: Airy transitions with large glass surfaces.

faq.q: Can an insect screen be fitted?
faq.a: Yes, sliding or pleated insect-screen integration is possible.
It provides high insulation with a multi-chamber profile and insulated glass.

panjur.title: Roller Shutter Systems
panjur.short: Motorised and manual roller shutter solutions providing heat, light and security control.
panjur.intro: Roller shutter systems are versatile solutions providing thermal insulation, light control and security. With monoblock and surface-mounted options, they are suitable for both new and existing buildings.

advantages.title: Light Control

advantages.title: Security

advantages.title: Motorised Comfort

faq.q: Does it work during a power cut?

faq.q: Can it come with an insect screen?

kepenk.title: Rolling Shutter (Kepenk) Systems
kepenk.short: High-security automatic rolling shutter solutions for businesses and warehouses.
kepenk.intro: Rolling shutter systems provide top-level security and durability for businesses and commercial areas. With automatic and manual options they offer fast and secure opening and closing.

advantages.title: High Security

advantages.title: Automatic Use
advantages.description: Fast, motorised and remote-controlled opening.

advantages.title: Durability
advantages.description: A mechanism suited to heavy use.

advantages.title: Emergency Control
advantages.description: Manual opening during a power cut.

faq.a: Perforated/transparent slat options are available for showcase visibility.

aluminyum-cit.title: Aluminium Fence Systems
aluminyum-cit.short: Modern, durable and maintenance-free fence systems for garden and site perimeters.
aluminyum-cit.intro: Aluminium fence systems create an aesthetic and secure boundary for garden and land perimeters with their corrosion-resistant structure, modern louvre designs and wide range of colours.

advantages.title: Maintenance-Free

aluminyum-panel-kapi.title: Aluminium Panel Doors
aluminyum-panel-kapi.short: Thermally insulated, secure and prestigious aluminium panel doors for villa entrances.
aluminyum-panel-kapi.intro: Aluminium panel doors add prestige to villa and residential entrances with their elegant designs, thermally insulated infill panels and high-security hardware. They offer a wide range of models and colours.

advantages.title: Prestigious Entrance

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation

advantages.title: Durability

aluminyum-katlanir-kapi.title: Folding Aluminium Doors
aluminyum-katlanir-kapi.short: Accordion-type glass door systems that fold to the side and open fully, with wide openings.
aluminyum-katlanir-kapi.intro: Folding (accordion) aluminium doors fully open the aperture by folding the panels to the side. They are a flexible and modern solution that seamlessly connects indoor and outdoor spaces.

advantages.title: Full Opening
advantages.description: The panels fold and the aperture opens completely.

advantages.title: Wide Use
advantages.description: Ideal flexibility for large openings.

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation

advantages.title: Modern Aesthetics
advantages.description: Slim profiles and wide glass surfaces.

faq.q: How many panels can there be?

A threshold-free transition can be achieved with a floor-recessed rail.

pergola-tente.title: Pergola & Awning
pergola-tente.short: Aesthetic shading with articulated, cassette and fixed awning systems.
pergola-tente.intro: Pergola and awning systems provide aesthetic and functional shading against the sun in your outdoor areas. With articulated, cassette and box-type options, we offer solutions suitable for every space.

advantages.title: Aesthetic Look
advantages.description: Elegant designs in harmony with the architecture.

advantages.title: Wide Span
advantages.description: Uninterrupted shade over large areas.

kaldir-sur.title: Lift-and-Slide Systems
kaldir-sur.short: Highly insulated sliding systems with large, heavy glass panels using lift-and-slide technology.
kaldir-sur.intro: Lift-and-slide systems allow even large and heavy glass panels to be slid effortlessly. When the panel is lifted, the gaskets engage to provide superior thermal, sound and water insulation.

advantages.title: Large Panels
advantages.description: Easy movement of heavy and large glass.

advantages.title: Superior Insulation

advantages.title: Comfortable Use
advantages.description: Smooth movement with the lift-and-slide mechanism.

advantages.title: Uninterrupted View

otomatik-kapi.title: Automatic Photocell Doors

otomatik-kapi.intro: Automatic door systems provide comfort, hygiene and energy efficiency in high-footfall areas with their photocell sliding, revolving and industrial models.

advantages.title: Comfortable Passage

advantages.title: Energy Efficiency
advantages.description: Reduces heat loss with fast closing.

advantages.title: Safety Sensors
advantages.description: Anti-jamming safety systems.

advantages.title: Quiet Operation

faq.q: Does it open during a power cut?

pvc-isi-yalitimli.title: Thermally Insulated PVC Systems
pvc-isi-yalitimli.short: High-performance insulated PVC door and window systems that prioritise energy savings.
pvc-isi-yalitimli.intro: Thermally insulated PVC systems significantly reduce energy costs with their multi-chamber profile structure, double/triple gaskets and Low-E insulated glass options. They are the ideal solution for comfortable and economical living spaces.

advantages.title: Energy Savings
advantages.description: Lower heating-cooling costs with superior insulation.

advantages.title: Comfort
advantages.description: Stable indoor temperature and condensation control.

kasetli-tente.title: Cassette Awning
kasetli-tente.short: Elegant and durable awning systems with a closed cassette that fully protects the fabric.
kasetli-tente.intro: Cassette awning systems provide long life and an elegant look with a cassette structure that fully encloses the fabric and mechanism when closed. They offer aesthetic shading on balconies and façades.

advantages.title: Fabric Protection

advantages.title: Elegant Look

faq.q: Can an insect screen be fitted?

seksiyonel-garaj.title: Sectional Garage Doors

seksiyonel-garaj.intro: Sectional garage doors provide maximum space savings by opening parallel to the ceiling. With their thermally insulated panels and quiet motors, they are an indispensable solution for modern homes.

advantages.title: Space Saving
advantages.description: Opens parallel to the ceiling, takes no space at the front.

advantages.title: Thermal Insulation

advantages.title: Quiet Motor
advantages.description: Comfortable and low-noise operation.

advantages.title: Security
advantages.description: Anti-jamming sensor and finger-protected panels.

faq.q: Can a side door be added?

plisseri-sineklik.title: Pleated Insect Screens

plisseri-sineklik.intro: Pleated insect-screen systems offer elegant insect protection for your windows and doors with their accordion-folding structure. They take up little space, are easy to use and long-lasting.

advantages.title: Elegant Structure
advantages.description: An elegant look with foldable pleats.

advantages.title: Easy Use
advantages.description: Soft and quiet opening and closing.

advantages.title: Takes Little Space

advantages.title: Wide Compatibility
advantages.description: Applicable to windows and doors.

faq.a: Comfortable passage is provided with low-profile base options.
A double-leaf pleated option is available for wide openings.

sundurma.title: Canopy Systems
sundurma.short: Durable glass and polycarbonate canopy solutions for entrances, terraces and car park areas.

advantages.title: Durable Structure
advantages.description: Aluminium carrier construction.

advantages.title: Custom Size

havuz-kapama.title: Pool Enclosure Systems
havuz-kapama.short: Sliding and telescopic glass enclosure systems that make your pool usable in all four seasons.
havuz-kapama.intro: Pool enclosure systems, with their telescopic and sliding structure, cover your pool to provide four-season use, safety and cleanliness. They reduce heat loss and lower maintenance costs.

advantages.title: Four-Season Use
advantages.description: Year-round enjoyment by covering the pool.

advantages.title: Safety
advantages.description: Protection for children and pets.

advantages.title: Cleanliness

about.title: Adding value to structures since 2020
about.description: Celyx Prime Global is a trust-focused building systems company that brings together engineering discipline with modern architectural aesthetics.
about.storyTitle: A name for experience and trust
about.storyLead: Celyx Prime Global is a premium building solutions company that offers all the systems modern structures need under one roof.
storyParagraphs: Since 2020 we have been producing solutions for residential and commercial projects in PVC, aluminium, glass and shading systems. We place engineering discipline, quality materials and a modern architectural understanding at the centre of our work.

With our Istanbul Maltepe–based team, we have brought to life projects of different scales — from villas to mass housing, from offices to restaurants. Thanks to our bespoke approach to every project, we offer designs tailored to the space rather than standard solutions.

We are with you throughout the entire process — from survey to project design, from production to installation and after-sales support. Our aim is not merely to sell products, but to build long-lasting, aesthetic and comfortable living spaces.

pvc-aluminyum-karsilastirmasi.title: PVC vs Aluminium: Which Is Right for You?
pvc-aluminyum-karsilastirmasi.excerpt: We compare PVC and aluminium joinery systems in terms of thermal insulation, durability, aesthetics and cost.
content: One of the most common questions when choosing window and door systems is the difference between PVC and aluminium. Both materials have their own advantages, and the right choice depends on the needs of the project.

PVC systems offer superior thermal and sound insulation. Thanks to their multi-chamber profile structure they provide energy savings and are generally more economical. With their maintenance-free surface they are frequently preferred in residential projects.

Aluminium systems, on the other hand, stand out with their high strength and slim-profile aesthetics. They are ideal for modern architectural projects requiring large glass surfaces and wide openings. With thermally insulated (thermal-break) series, energy performance is also strong.

In short: if maximum insulation and economy are the priority, PVC stands out; if slim profiles and large openings are the priority, aluminium comes to the fore. In mixed projects, solutions using both systems together are also possible.

kis-bahcesi-secerken-dikkat.title: What to Consider When Choosing a Winter Garden
kis-bahcesi-secerken-dikkat.excerpt: Thermal insulation, glass selection and ventilation details for a four-season winter garden.
content: A winter garden is a space that connects your living area with nature and that you can enjoy in all four seasons. However, if the right system is not chosen, the expectation of comfort may not be met.
The first point to consider is thermal insulation. Thermal-break aluminium profiles and Low-E coated insulated glass provide an environment that is cool in summer and warm in winter.
Ventilation is also critical. Motorised roof windows and side openings create ideal air circulation indoors and prevent condensation.
Finally, the roof slope and water drainage must be designed correctly, and the glass to be used must be chosen in accordance with safety (tempered/laminated) standards.

pergola-sistemleri-rehberi.title: Pergola Systems Guide: Bioclimatic, Cassette and Fixed
pergola-sistemleri-rehberi.excerpt: In this guide we cover the different pergola types, their use areas and selection criteria.
content: Pergola systems are one of the most effective solutions that turn outdoor areas into livable spaces. Choosing the right pergola type depends on the intended use.
Bioclimatic pergolas control sun, air and rain thanks to their adjustable louvres. With smart-home integration they are the most comfortable option.
Cassette and articulated awning systems, on the other hand, provide more economical shading and are suitable for narrow areas. Fixed pergolas offer decorative and permanent solutions.
When choosing, the size of the area, frequency of use, climate conditions and budget should be taken into account.

giyotin-cam-sistemleri.title: Guillotine Glass Systems: The New Standard of Modern Enclosure
giyotin-cam-sistemleri.excerpt: The advantages of guillotine glass systems, their use areas and points to consider.
content: Guillotine glass systems are modern enclosure solutions in which the glass moves vertically up and down. They stand out with their space savings and uninterrupted view.
Thanks to their slim aluminium profiles, maximum glass surface is achieved and the space looks more spacious. Manual or motorised options are available.
They are frequently preferred for balcony enclosures, café façades and winter gardens. Multi-point locking systems provide security and wind resistance.
The correct glass thickness and a quality rail mechanism are critical for the system to work reliably and last a long time.

aluminyum-dograma-rehberi.title: Aluminium Joinery Guide: Series, Glass and Colour Selection
aluminyum-dograma-rehberi.excerpt: How should you decide on profile series, glass package and colour when choosing aluminium joinery?
content: Aluminium joinery is one of the most preferred systems in modern architecture. A few basic criteria should be considered to make the right choice.
The profile series is determined according to the insulation need. Thermal-break series are ideal for spaces requiring thermal insulation.
The glass package is chosen according to climate and noise conditions. Double or triple insulated glass provides energy efficiency.
Colour and surface options are wide; harmony with the architecture is achieved with electrostatic powder coating and wood-patterned coatings.
